name: Source Speaker Tracing Challenge 2024
description: Challenge benchmark for source speaker tracing in converted speech. Systems must identify the original speaker behind voice-converted audio and may also recognize the voice conversion method as an auxiliary task.
evaluation_method: accuracy/top-k accuracy for source speaker tracing, and classification accuracy/F1 for conversion method recognition
notes: Challenge-style benchmark introduced for STL 2024 with a large-scale converted speech database built from 16 common voice conversion methods. Designed to address data scarcity in source speaker verification/tracing. Exact question count is not specified. Citations reported: 5.
